name: RetroArch

biosRequirements.label: Game Boy Advance BIOS (optional)
biosRequirements.note: mGBA runs games without it. OmniPC also copies gba_bios.bin from BIOS\gba into RetroArch's system folder. OmniPC never downloads BIOS files.

biosRequirements.label: Famicom Disk System BIOS (only for .fds games)
biosRequirements.note: Only Famicom Disk System (.fds) games need it. OmniPC also copies disksys.rom from BIOS\nes into RetroArch's system folder.

notes: OmniPC installs the official stable RetroArch build from buildbot.libretro.com (version taken from the latest github.com/libretro/RetroArch release). libretro publishes no checksums, so OmniPC records the SHA-256 of what it downloaded.

Cores are downloaded from the official libretro buildbot (nightly/windows/x86_64/latest, the same source as RetroArch's Core Downloader) into Emulators\retroarch\data\cores, so RetroArch updates and rollbacks keep them. Defaults: NES mesen, SNES snes9x, N64 mupen64plus_next, Game Boy/Color gambatte, GBA mgba, Mega Drive/Genesis genesis_plus_gx (32X: picodrive), arcade fbneo. Override per system with the advanced setting core|<system>.
retroarch.cfg lives in the OmniPC data folder and is passed with --config; saves, states and screenshots go to the OmniPC Saves folder, never next to the ROMs.
RetroArch has one shared system folder for every core. OmniPC uses BIOS\retroarch for it and copies known BIOS files (gba_bios.bin, disksys.rom) from the per-system BIOS folders into it.

Controller bindings are written for the XInput driver. Per-system variants (Nintendo layout swap, per-system overrides) are kept in data\omnideck\input-<system>.cfg and appended at launch with --appendconfig.

config_save_on_exit is off so RetroArch never writes launch-time values back into retroarch.cfg. Use Main Menu > Configuration File > Save Current Configuration, core/game overrides or remap files (stored in data\config) to keep changes made inside RetroArch.
Internal resolution and other emulation settings are core options (Quick Menu > Core Options), not managed by OmniPC.

PlayStation, PSP and Nintendo DS are not set up through RetroArch: those systems use DuckStation, PPSSPP and melonDS. RetroArch's PS1 cores need a BIOS in the system folder and the PPSSPP core needs extra assets, which OmniPC does not provision.
assumptions: Verified against libretro/RetroArch tag v1.22.2 (the GitHub release marked Latest; raw sources for configuration.c, config.def.h, retroarch.c, gfx/video_defines.h, menu/menu_defines.h, version.all) and master @ 01b902b (2026-10-10, settings/ and input/ sources).

Download URL https://buildbot.libretro.com/stable/<version>/windows/x86_64/RetroArch.7z and its RetroArch-Win64/ top folder holding retroarch.exe: NOT verified from this sandbox (buildbot.libretro.com is blocked). Based on the buildbot's published stable layout and EmuDeck-WE (vars.ps1 $url_ra = .../nightly/windows/x86_64/RetroArch.7z; emuDeckRetroArch.ps1 RetroArch_install moves temp/ra/RetroArch-Win64). OmniPC's findContentRoot handles the sub-folder. The full RetroArch.7z (not RetroArch_update.7z) is assumed to ship assets/, autoconfig/, info/ and shaders/.
GitHub tags are 'v1.22.2' style; VersionedUrlSource strips the leading 'v', giving the buildbot folder name '1.22.2'. No upstream checksum exists for buildbot files.

Core URL https://buildbot.libretro.com/nightly/windows/x86_64/latest/<core>_libretro.dll.zip and core names (mesen, fceumm, snes9x, mupen64plus_next, gambatte, mgba, genesis_plus_gx, picodrive, fbneo, ...) taken from EmuDeck-WE emuDeckRetroArch.ps1 RetroArch_install ($RAcores list + url). Each zip is assumed to hold only <core>_libretro.dll; OmniPC rejects anything else and checks the MZ header.
Windows RetroArch and cores are MinGW builds and need no Visual C++ runtime (assumption; no MSVC runtime DLLs are imported by the official buildbot builds).

retroarch.exe has no VERSIONINFO resource (media/rarch.rc), so the version comes from 'retroarch --version', which prints 'Version: x.y.z' to stdout and exit(0)s in the first argument pass before config/video/input init (retroarch.c retroarch_print_version, case RA_OPT_VERSION). frontend_win32_attach_console (frontend/drivers/platform_win32.c) leaves already-connected pipe handles alone, so piped output is captured.

CLI (retroarch.c long_options): --config/-c <file>, --appendconfig <file1|file2> (configuration.c config_load_file: '|'-delimited, appended values override the main config), -L/--libretro <core path>, -f/--fullscreen, content path as the last argument. Unknown options print help and retroarch_fail(), so OmniPC only passes through -v/--verbose, --set-shader, -M/--sram-mode, -e/--entryslot, --subsystem from custom args.

Default Windows directories are relative to the exe (':\' prefix, platform_win32.c frontend_win32_env_get): :\cores, :\info, :\system, :\saves, :\states, :\config, :\config\remaps, :\playlists, :\thumbnails, :\assets, :\autoconfig, :\shaders. OmniPC redirects savefile_directory, savestate_directory, system_directory, libretro_directory, screenshot_directory, rgui_config_directory, input_remapping_directory, playlist_directory, thumbnails_directory, cache_directory and log_dir (configuration.c SETTING_PATH/SETTING_ARRAY). libretro_info_path stays :\info (shipped with RetroArch; cores load with -L without .info files).

savefiles_in_content_dir / savestates_in_content_dir / systemfiles_in_content_dir default false and sort_savefiles_enable / sort_savestates_enable default true (config.def.h), so saves land in Saves\retroarch\saves\<core name>\.

Startup/exit prompts: RetroArch has no first-run wizard or update check on Windows. The exit hotkey needs a second press while quit_press_twice (v1.22.2, DEFAULT_QUIT_PRESS_TWICE true) / confirm_quit (master, migrated from quit_press_twice) is true, so both are written false. rgui_show_start_screen (menu_show_start_screen, default true) is turned off. pause_nonactive (default true) is turned off so the game does not freeze when focus is lost at start. quit_on_close_content = 2 (QUIT_ON_CLOSE_CONTENT_CLI, menu/menu_defines.h) exits when content launched from the command line is closed.

Logging (verbosity.c rarch_log_file_init, retroarch.c): logging to file needs log_verbosity = true and log_to_file = true; with log_to_file_timestamp = false the file is <log_dir>/retroarch.log (FILE_PATH_DEFAULT_EVENT_LOG).

Graphics keys: video_driver (d3d11, d3d12, vulkan, glcore, gl), video_fullscreen, video_vsync, aspect_ratio_index (gfx/video_defines.h enum aspect_ratio: 4:3=0, 16:9=1, core=22, full=24). Hardware-rendered cores (mupen64plus_next) switch to a compatible driver themselves (driver_switch_enable, default on).

XInput joypad (input/drivers_joypad/xinput_joypad.c button_index_to_bitmap_code): buttons 0=A 1=B 2=X 3=Y 4=LB 5=RB 6=Start 7=Back 8=L3 9=R3 10=Guide; d-pad is hat h0up/h0down/h0left/h0right; axes 0=LX 1=LY 2=RX 3=RY 4=LT 5=RT, with LY/RY positive = up (so RetroPad l_y_plus/down = '-1'), matching retroarch-joypad-autoconfig xinput/XInput_Controller.cfg. 'nul' clears a bind (configuration.c input_config_parse_joy_axis/button).

Bind keys (configuration.c input_config_bind_map, input_config_get_prefix): player binds input_player1_<b|a|y|x|l|r|l2|r2|l3|r3|select|start|up|down|left|right|l_x_plus|l_x_minus|l_y_plus|l_y_minus|r_x_plus|r_x_minus|r_y_plus|r_y_minus>_<btn|axis>; meta binds input_<enable_hotkey|exit_emulator|save_state|load_state|volume_up|volume_down|menu_toggle|toggle_fast_forward|screenshot|toggle_fullscreen>_<btn|axis>; input_player1_joypad_index, input_analog_deadzone, input_rumble_gain (0-100), input_hotkey_block_delay. RetroPad positions follow the SNES layout (B bottom, A right, Y left, X top). Explicit binds take precedence over autoconfig profiles; a bind cleared to 'nul' falls back to the autoconfig profile's bind for that slot.
Per-core overrides (config/<core>/<core>.cfg) are applied after --appendconfig, so a user's own core override still wins over OmniPC's per-system bindings.
